entries.title: Press a card's choice from the keyboard
entries.body: The first four choices on the card in front of you each show a key, ⌘1 through ⌘4 from left to right, or Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+4 on Linux. A key presses its choice the same way a click does. An empty reply box shows ⇧⌘L, or Ctrl+Shift+L on Linux, which puts the cursor there.

picture.alt: A decision card on a Mac whose Not now and Approve buttons show ⌘1 and ⌘2, and whose empty reply field shows ⇧⌘L
